title: An unused Website Opportunities demo freezes after its term, is torn down through the site's own delete after the grace, and Extend/Reopen/Rebuild and the Demo column follow it
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-demo-retention.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-doors.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/ops-wo.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/site-publish.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-wo-views/test/demo.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-wo-views/test/place-card-demo.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A demo whose demo_expires_at passed is frozen by the sweep; one frozen longer than demoFreezeGraceDays goes through teardownSiteAs and gets demo_deleted_at only once its site row is gone; the build row, revision and opportunity stay.

Over demoMaxPerAccount / demoMaxPerHost / demoDiskHighWaterPct the least recently touched live demos are frozen, never deleted; a sweep does at most demoSweepBatch operations; a second instance holding the advisory lock makes the run answer {ran:false, reason:'busy'}; demoRetentionEnabled false changes nothing.
PUT /api/ops/wo/settings with a demo key out of range answers 400 INVALID_DEMO_RETENTION; a save of some keys keeps the others.

POST /api/website-opportunities/:id/demo/reopen thaws a frozen demo (409 DEMO_NOT_FROZEN on a live one); /extend pushes a live one (409 DEMO_FROZEN on a frozen one); /rebuild answers 409 DEMO_NOT_DELETED until deleted, then builds the same revision once per requestId; hand-off of a frozen demo answers 409 DEMO_FROZEN.
The Demo column's countdown: > 3 days calm, ≤ 3 days soon with Extend, < 24 hours urgent in hours with Extend; frozen shows days until deletion; deleted shows Rebuild.

Stand wo2 fixes: the website-opportunities switch off stops the sweep ({ran:false, reason:"switch-off"}); a deleted demo has wo_build.state "deleted", is not stage "demo", and Rebuild takes it; the grid card shows the Demo line after Website; a demo just built on a 14-day term says 14 days left.
fence: sweepDemos under pg_try_advisory_lock(DEMO_RETENTION_LOCK_ID); deletion only through the site delete operation (teardownSiteAs); the demo doors' state refusals

tests: the sweep freezes demos whose term ran out
a demo frozen past the grace goes through the teardown
over demoMaxPerAccount the coldest live demos
a second instance finds the sweep taken
switched off, the sweep changes nothing
reopen thaws a frozen demo; extend pushes a live one
rebuild makes a new demo from the old revision
3 days or less: soon, with Extend
switch off: the demo retention tick freezes nothing
a deleted demo is not "Demo built"
a grid card draws the Demo line right after Website
a demo just built with a 14-day term says 14 days left
